title: 2021–2022 Social Sciences Frieda L. Miller Fellow Massachusetts Institute of Technology
bio: Anne Whiston Spirn is the Cecil and Ida Green Distinguished Professor of Landscape Architecture and Planning at Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Her work is devoted to promoting life-sustaining communities: places that are functional, sustainable, meaningful, artful, and just. Since 1987, she has directed the West Philadelphia Landscape Project, where action research addresses issues of poverty, race, troubled schools, deteriorated neighborhoods, and polluted water.
